sources.note: Nothing. The article is about age of acquisition ('Late Vernacular Production'); its only Keijar content is the Table 2 row (village Keder Lama: children reported to fully understand the vernacular at 10+ and produce it fluently at 10+, from Lee & Wambaliau 2004) and a p. 22 citation of the same survey on subsistence economy. Searched the full text for stress/tone/accent/phonolog: the 8 hits are all in the general L2-acquisition literature review (foreign accent, phonological acquisition), none about any Tor-Orya language. Useful only as a pointer: it confirms the Kwanem draft survey is 'not…
